  • Conduct research and prepare executive summaries.
  • Assist leadership with operational planning and administrative priorities.

Meeting & Event Coordination

  • Organize executive meetings, board meetings, off-sites, and company events.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, and briefing materials.
  • Record meeting notes and distribute action items.
  • Coordinate virtual and in-person meeting logistics.
  • Ensure follow-through on executive priorities and commitments.

Administrative Operations

  • Maintain confidential records, contracts, and documentation.
  • Process expense reports, invoicing, and budget tracking.
  • Organize executive documentation and filing systems.
  • Improve administrative processes and operational workflows.
  • Support executive office operations with accuracy and efficiency.

What Success Looks Like

  • Executive calendars run smoothly with minimal oversight.
  • Meetings, priorities, and strategic projects remain organized and on schedule.
  • Leadership receives proactive, timely, and reliable support.
  • Travel and logistics are coordinated seamlessly.
  • Confidential information is handled with the highest level of professionalism.
  • Administrative systems become increasingly efficient and scalable.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proactive and resourceful with a strong ownership mindset.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Calm under pressure and capable of managing competing priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Professional, trustworthy, and highly discreet.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as an:
    • Executive Assistant
    • Senior Administrative Assistant
    • Chief of Staff
    • Executive Operations professional
  • Proven experience supporting:
    • CEOs
    • Founders
    • Presidents
    • C-Suite executives
  • Experience managing complex calendars, executive communications, and high-priority projects.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in:
    • Business Administration
    • Communications
    • Related field
  • Experience supporting leadership in:
    • Startups
    • Consulting
    • Finance
    • Legal
    • Technology
    • High-growth organizations
  • Experience coordinating domestic and international travel.
  • Experience preparing executive presentations and reports.
  • Experience working with board members and senior stakeholders.

Tools & Platforms

  • Microsoft Office Suite
    • Outlook
    • Word
    • Excel
    • PowerPoint
  • Google Workspace
    • Gmail
    • Calendar
    • Docs
    • Sheets
    • Drive
  • Project management platforms such as:
    • Asana
    • Monday.com
    • Notion
    • Trello
  • Video conferencing platforms:
    • Zoom
    • Microsoft Teams
    • Google Meet
  • Expense and travel management tools

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Manage executive calendars and scheduling priorities.
  • Coordinate meetings across multiple time zones.
  • Organize executive communications and inbox management.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, and meeting materials.
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel.
  • Track strategic initiatives and follow up on action items.
  • Support leadership with operational and administrative priorities.
  • Improve executive support workflows and organizational processes.

In short: You’ll serve as the operational backbone for executive leadership, ensuring priorities stay on track, communication flows seamlessly, and executives can focus on driving the business forward.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Executive calendar accuracy and scheduling efficiency.
  • Timely completion of executive priorities and follow-ups.
  • Quality and responsiveness of executive communications.
  • Successful coordination of meetings, travel, and logistics.
  • Administrative process improvements.
  • Leadership satisfaction and operational reliability.
  • Accuracy and confidentiality of executive documentation.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Trusted partnership with executive leadership.
  • High visibility across strategic business initiatives.
  • Opportunity to influence operational excellence at the executive level.
  • Diverse responsibilities spanning executive support, operations, and project coordination.
  • Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Career progression into:
    • Chief of Staff
    • Executive Operations Manager
    • Operations Director
    • Business Operations Lead

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your experience supporting executives, managing complex calendars, coordinating high-priority projects, handling confidential information, and helping senior leaders stay organized and productive. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about executive support, thrive in high-accountability environments, and enjoy helping senior leaders operate at their best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a trusted partner to executive leadership in a growing organization.

This is an opportunity to join a practice during its foundational growth phase and help shape the future of regional remote radiology coverage.

Candidate Requirements

Why Palmetto?

Palmetto is more than a teleradiology job.
It is a physician-designed practice built to provide flexibility, support, and long-term career growth in a rapidly evolving radiology landscape.
Whether your goal is maximizing income, creating a more sustainable schedule, or helping build something new, Palmetto offers a unique opportunity to do so within the stability and resources of Radiology Partners.
If you're looking for a remote radiology opportunity that combines autonomy, flexibility, operational excellence, and genuine partnership potential, we'd love to connect.

Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology, service and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Description & requirements

Description
Mi smo zaljubljenici u korisničko iskustvo, podjednako strastveni prema našim klijentima kao i njihovi najvjerniji obožavatelji. Možete nas pronaći iza sjaja fintech inovatora, tehnoloških legendi i mnogih drugih. Trenutno tražimo specijalista/icu korisničke podrške na njemačkom jeziku zaklijenta iz energetske industrije, poznatog po svojoj predanosti održivosti i inovacijama.Želimo da se pridružiš našem timu!
Što je tu za TEBE?
  • Međunarodno i inkluzivno okruženje u kojem se od prvog dana osjećaš podržano, ohrabreno i dobrodošlo
  • Organizirana obuka koja će te upoznati sa svim specifičnostima posla
  • Kontinuirani razvoj kroz naše interne platforme za učenje
  • Neograničene prilike za napredovanje: 90% naših menadžera započelo je karijeru u korisničkoj podršci
  • Korporativne pogodnosti, popusti te bonus dobrodošlice i bonus za preporuke novih djelatnika
  • Mogućnost ostvarivanja prodajnih bonusa
Pridruži nam se kao specijalist/ica korisničke podrške na njemačkom jeziku!
Budi prva linija podrške korisnicima i ostvari stvaran utjecaj na razini cijele tvrtke. U ovoj ulozi ćeš:
  • Raditi za pružatelja komunalnih usluga u Njemačkoj, koji korisnicima nudi rješenja u području električne energije, plina, vode i grijanja
  • Osiguravati izvrsno korisničko iskustvo pravovremenim i točnim odgovorima na upite putem telefona i e-maila
  • Aktivno doprinositi uspjehu projekta – predlagati poboljšanja, dijeliti znanje i učiti zajedno s kolegama
  • Raditi u smjenama pon-pet 8:00-18:00 sati prva 3 mjeseca, a nakon toga 8:00-20:00 sati
  • Veći dio radnog vremena provoditi u telefonskoj komunikaciji s korisnicima, a ostatak u obradi upita i drugim backoffice zadacima
Za uspjeh u ovoj ulozi potrebno je:
  • Izvrsno poznavanje njemačkog jezika (C1 razina ili više) u govoru i pismu
  • Odlične komunikacijske i međuljudske vještine – poput empatije i aktivnog slušanja
  • Sposobnost brzog usvajanja informacija, prilagodbe i reagiranja na promjene
  • Pozitivan stav i želja za pružanjem izvrsnog korisničkog iskustva – vjeruješ da korisnici zaslužuju više od same podrške
  • Sposobnost prepoznavanja prodajnih prilika kroz razgovor s korisnicima te izražene prodajne vještine
Za rad od kuće potrebno je imati:
  • Stabilnu internetsku vezu brzine najmanje 10 Mbps ili više
Kako je raditi u Transcomu?
U Transcomu smo neumorno predani našim klijentima i jedni drugima. Svakog dana netko započne svoje putovanje s Transcomom. Njegujući potencijal koji imaju danas, pretvaraju ga u vještine za budućnost. Prepoznajemo trud, timski rad i spremnost na pomoć drugima. Potičemo dugoročne pozitivne promjene u svojim timovima i zajednici. Takvi smo u Transcomu. Ovdje brinemo i navijamo jedni za druge. Prihvaćamo vas baš takve kakvi jeste, od prvog dana. Uz ispravan stav i motivaciju, mogućnosti su gotovo neograničene.

raw.description:
The Role:

The Minted Wedding Concierge will join our team to provide virtual sales consultations for our wedding customers in an effort to increase revenue. You'll give customers a personalized tour and shopping experience of Minted products and services, with a focus on building relationships, upselling, and using your knowledge of Minted's products to create the best possible experience. Specialists will use their strong relationship-building skills, knowledge of Minted’s products, and upselling skills to build the best possible customer experience while focusing on sales.

Reporting to the Manager, Wedding Concierge Program, you will be an empathetic and passionate team member whose main objective is to offer the best possible customer experience while generating revenue. Our operation is open 7 days per week, and candidates must be available to work weekends and evenings. The hours & schedule for the role are variable.

You will:

  • Host 30-minute consultations to help customers personalize their design choices and generate revenue
  • Actively support revenue growth by leveraging soft sales strategies and tactics, ensuring customers feel comfortable throughout the process.
  • Upsell and cross-sell during all consultations in order to help the customer find the best possible stationery and/or decor
  • Serve as dedicated customer advocate and brand ambassador, influencing the prospective customer’s perception of Minted
  • Answer questions about Minted’s full suite of products and services, customization, and assistance with how to place orders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams when additional support is needed
  • Document customer interactions thoroughly and accurately in our CRM
  • Use support tools & training, including our knowledge base to respond to inquiries and ensure our customers’ satisfaction and a high-quality experience
  • Identify opportunities for improving the customer experience and share those with leadership
  • Attain the highest quality possible, with accountability for your own Quality and Productivity KPIs
  • Perform additional duties and projects as assigned by management

You are:

  • Able to confidently, positively, and efficiently guide the customer through Minted’s product and service offerings, and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
  • Personable and engaging, building relationships with customers, including cross-selling and up-selling
  • Able to take direction and quickly learn new procedures, processes, and products
  • Open to feedback, believing in a culture of continuous improvement as you work toward individual and departmental goals
  • Technologically adept; familiarity and experience with eCommerce a plus
  • Able to reliably meet a required flexible/variable hour work schedule including weekends (at least one weekend day is required) based on business needs and adhere to company attendance policy

You have:

  • Strong sales orientation and love for supporting the customer
  • A calm, professional working environment conducive to a high-touch consultation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • High attention to detail, organized, and able to follow through
  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM software a plus
  • The ability to appropriately represent the Minted brand on screen with customers
  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 2+ years of experience working with customers (preferably at a premium brand)
  • Sales, concierge, or account management experience required
Compensation:
The compensation range for the role applies to employment offers from Minted. Our employment offers fall between the minimum and midpoint of the range to allow for continued salary growth during your employment at Minted. The upper half of the range accommodates this growth and supports our intention to create an environment that encourages lasting relationships between Minted and our employees.
Geo Base Full Salary Range 2 - Includes CO, IL, MA, MD, NJ, OR, RI, TX, VT, VA, WA - $22.23- $29.18
Geo Base Full Salary Range 3 - Includes AL, AK, AZ, AR, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, MT, ND, NE, NM, NV, NH, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, TN, UT, WI, WV, WY- $20.40 - $26.78
Salaries will vary based on various factors, including but not limited to professional and academic experience, associated job responsibilities, and/or other business or organizational needs.

This role is hourly paid

Benefits:

Benefits will be effective on the first of each month following your initial hire date.
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
- Employer-Funded Health Savings Account
- 10 Paid Holidays
- Paid Time Off and Sick Leave
- Paid Parental Leave
- Monthly Gym/Wellness Reimbursement
- 401(k) retirement savings plan
- Employer-Funded Commuter Benefits
- Employee Discount
- Friends and Family Discount

DISCLAIMER:

We verify identity at the start of interviews to ensure fairness and security. We reserve the right to withdraw candidates who misrepresent their identity, experience, or qualifications at any stage of the process.

Notice of AI Use in Employment Decisions:

We use AI-powered tools, including Brainner AI, to support our hiring and employment processes. These tools help assess job-related qualifications and improve efficiency, but all decisions involve human review.
About Minted:
Artists shape culture. They spark conversation, create connection, and bring beauty into the world. Minted is where they come together to reach further. Our marketplace empowers a thriving community of independent artists to sell and scale their work. We nurture self-expression, cultivate community, and bring the best in visual art to a global audience.
We’re building a new way to discover the world’s best creative talent. We’re here for the emerging talent ready to take off, the local favorites ready to grow, and the established artists ready to dream bigger.
At Minted, our people don’t just believe in the power of art–we live it. We have our finger on the pulse of what’s new and now. We’re obsessed with great design, art, and interiors. We’re in galleries, at fairs, and constantly finding inspiration online. We seek undiscovered talent that deserves to stand up and stand out. We connect with artists that have something to say, and we collaborate to amplify their work. The Minted community’s art, stationery, and textiles products have reached over 75 million homes worldwide.
Our marketplace brings the best in independent design to consumers everywhere. We recognize the challenges independent artists face, and we leverage our resources to level the playing field and create a platform that gives artists the freedom to develop their craft and grow their business.
We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA and currently employ 350+ full-time employees, plus additional temporary workers during the holiday season. We have raised over $300M from top-tier investors including Benchmark Capital, T. Rowe Price, Permira, Ridge Ventures, Technology Crossover Ventures, and Norwest Venture Partners. Angel investors include Marissa Mayer, Jeremy Stoppelman, Julia & Kevin Hartz, Yishan Wong, and more.

Telstra Health proudly delivers the 1800RESPECT Service. This is the national 24/7 domestic, family and sexual violence counselling, information, and support service.

1800RESPECT provides free, confidential support for people experiencing, or at risk of experiencing, domestic, family, and sexual violence, including workplace sexual harassment. The Service also provides support for friends, family, and professionals.

About the role
As a First Response Counsellor in these part-time or full-time positions, you'll provide trauma-informed support via phone, video, web chat, and SMS in a fast-paced contact centre environment.

  • You'll have at least three years’ full-time counselling experience post qualification

About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

About the Role

You will lead hiring across software engineering functions including backend, mobile, desktop, infrastructure, and product engineering. You will partner closely with founding teams, leadership and engineering leaders to identify and attract high-caliber talent globally.

This role requires strong judgment, speed, sourcing ability, and deep understanding of engineering talent quality beyond resumes and brand names.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end hiring across assigned roles - from intake to close

  • Build pipelines from scratch using direct sourcing, referrals, and targeted outreach

  • Drive hiring decisions with clear signals, not just interview feedback

  • Keep processes moving - remove delays, chase feedback, close candidates

  • Redesign interview questions, scorecards, and assessments to raise hiring bar

  • Recruitment processes - improve speed, quality, and consistency across hiring

  • Build employer presence through content, messaging, and candidate experience

What You'll Need

  • Proven experience in recruiting / talent acquisition (in-house or agency)

  • Proven track record of closing roles in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong sourcing ability - able to generate pipelines without relying on inbound

  • Good judgment - able to identify strong candidates beyond resumes

  • Ability to manage multiple roles with speed and consistency

  • Willingness to challenge and improve existing processes

  • Clear, direct communication with hiring managers and candidates

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and high expectations

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

raw.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Cloud Engineering organization exists to manage that massive scale, constantly innovating to increase fleet-wide agility, efficiency, and reliability of the Netflix cloud infrastructure, while solving scale problems that we are the first to ever hit. We build, operate, and maintain Compute, Network, and Storage services so that developers at Netflix can rely on foundational building blocks when entertaining hundreds of millions of customers around the world. We run one of the largest cloud footprint. Join us as we push the boundaries of performance and resilience, empowering developers to create groundbreaking applications on a reliable platform.

We are looking to add a new stunning colleague to the following team:

Storage

Storage team focuses on providing storage and insights services to platforms, applications and users around the globe which are performant, secure and centrally managed; enabling platforms to move, store and efficiently archive data in the cloud. We offer a consistent mechanism to create & manage object/block/file resources, integrate Netflix ecosystem for access control and provide observability into the cost & lifecycle of these resources, by taking ownership of existing tools and shaping a more cohesive strategy. We manage storage at exabyte scale and enable Netflix to serve a huge amount of content around the globe.

Requirements:

Must-have skills:

  • 3-6 years of professional Software Engineering experience.

  • Recent and proficient experience with Java, C++, Go, Python, or similar.

  • Experience building & operating highly reliable distributed systems in a cloud environment.

  • Passion for technology, pragmatic thinking, ability to jump into an ambiguous area and break down complex problems.

What you'll be doing:

  • Building and operating Services, APIs, and Tooling for a variety of use-cases.

  • Balancing bias to action with the ability to make well-informed bets.

  • Engaging directly with end engineering users to understand their needs and improve their experience.

  • Understanding and solving business needs at scale with high-quality solutions.

  • Leaning into proactiveness and effective communication in pursuit of cross-functional alignment.

Success criteria:

  • You thrive in ambiguity; complex and fuzzy requirements are more common than clearly defined customer expectations.

  • You take incremental steps toward solving big problems; test-and-learn approaches work better than heads-down development.

  • You are independent and self-driven; progress is often self-directed by teams & individuals.

  • You’ve read about Netflix’s culture and think you would thrive here.

Here are a few recent talks and posts from members of the team to highlight the work we do:

  • Keeping Netflix Reliable Using Prioritized Load Shedding

  • How Netflix uses eBPF Flow logs

  • NATless IPv6/IPv4 Address Translation

  • Consistent caching mechanisms in Titus Gateway

  • Netflix Drive

  • Zero Configuration Service Mesh with On-Demand Cluster Discovery

  • Behind the Streams: Three Years Of Live at Netflix. Part 1

  • Behind the Streams: Three Years Of Live at Netflix. Part 2

*********

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $250,000.00 - $413,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusionis a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

raw.description:
Who We Are 

Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture-backed, high-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit www.marketbridge.com and follow www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/.

Who We’re Looking For

Marketbridge is looking for a Senior Go-To-Market Strategy Manager to join our Go-To-Market team to lead client engagements across marketing and sales disciplines, with a focus on revenue strategy and helping client organizations achieve their go-to-market goals by: 

  • Leading end to end project execution, including internal and external stakeholder management
  • Leading client meetings to present consulting deliverables
  • Developing and executing project plans to meet client and project objectives within defined scope / timeframe
  • Delivering recommendations through routes-to-market and strategic assessments   
  • Designing future state sales and partner strategy   
  • Developing sales coverage models, job roles, and commercial organization structures   
  • Integrating GTM through a combination of people, process, and technology  
  • Designing modern marketing strategies including audience segmentation, value propositions, demand-generation recommendations, and lifecycle engagement approaches.
  • Building marketing performance frameworks, KPIs, and operating models to help organizations optimize spend, improve ROI, and strengthen marketing’s contribution to revenue.
  • Creating financial models to support recommendations  

Responsibilities

  • Go-to-Market and Industry Expertise: Adept at developing solutions for clients in the Go-to-Market space including B2B channel strategy, B2B sales strategy & operations andmarketing strategy & operations.
  • Project and Client Management: Serve as the primary point person responsible for engagement delivery, managing project timelines, workstreams, deliverables, team members and clients to a satisfactory outcome. 
  • Strategic Analysis and Presentation Development: Develop and test hypotheses, research, craft solutions, and present findings to our clients, ultimately building consensus through fact-based narratives.  
  • People Management:  Manage analyst and consultant level resources on project engagements  

Qualifications

  • Prior management consulting experience required
  • Extensive business experience concentrated in customer facing functions such as sales, customer success, channel partnerships etc.
  • Has a bachelor’s degree in a related field, with an MBA or master’s degree preferred
  • Has 3-4 years of consulting experience and experience leading engagements large complex organizations (e.g.Fortune 500)
  • Can contribute to all aspects of the project lifecycle from hypothesis development to final presentation of deliverables, with leadership/ownership of multiple specific workstreams
  • Excellent oral and written communication / presentation skills
  • Can manage internal and external stakeholders while supporting projects end-to-end 
  • Has a strong foundation in Microsoft Office tools (particularly Excel and PowerPoint) and project collaboration tools (such as Monday.com) 

The Ideal Candidate Will:

  • Show extreme curiosity, with a love of continuous learning, a willingness to ask questions, and an interest in new tools and techniques  
  • Be an intellectually stimulated problem solver, a quick learner, a critical thinker, and an independent self-starter who can turn ambiguity into results  
  • Be a true team player with a positive attitude, who is comfortable collaborating on projects to deliver top quality work to our clients  
  • Have a strong leadership drive, a contagious enthusiasm for the work we do, and a friendly and approachable demeanor 
  • Prioritize innovation and strive to create the best solution with the resources available 

Our Culture

At Marketbridge, we pride ourselves on fostering an entrepreneurial culture filled with intellectually curious, high-spirited individuals committed to making a tangible impact each day. We value our people as our greatest asset, offering a workplace where high performers are acknowledged and rewarded. Working here means joining a team of the brightest minds in the industry, in an environment that champions professional growth and development through a mix of personal initiatives and company-supported learning. We believe in empowering our employees to own their career paths, supported by management guidance and organizational resources.

Our Benefits: We provide a benefits experience centered around wellness. It is important to us that every Marketbridger feels cared for and valued. 

  • Industry competitive compensation and performance-based bonuses 
  • Generous paid time off including vacation, holidays, sick leave, maternity/paternity leave, and Friday Summer hours 
  • A wide array of healthcare options including medical, dental, and vision coverage 
  • 401(k) savings plan with company match 
  • Marketbridge-led Social Committee 
  • Referral bonus program 
  • Mentor program for new hires 
  • Social events including holiday parties, baseball games, and happy hours 

Our Impact: From volunteering to fundraising, Marketbridgers regularly participate in activities that support humanitarian and environmental non-profit organizations (e.g., Doorways, One Love, Dress for Success). Some of these activities include: 

  • Volunteering at Shepherd’s Table, an organization that addresses food insecurity and homelessness 
  • Annual MarketBridge Valentine’s Day candygrams fundraiser 
  • Community service with the Rock Creek Conservancy to reduce litter and invasive plant species 

Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This role is remote, but our ideal candidate is able to work EST hours.
The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $175,000 USD with an eligible annual bonus of up to 20%.

Part-Time Career Coach (Flexible, Paid Workshop + Upside)

About CourseCareers

CourseCareers is an online education platform that helps people launch new careers without a college degree or prior experience.

We work with industry professionals to create job-focused courses that teach practical, employer-aligned skills in technology, business, trades, and operations. Our students are career changers looking for realistic, entry-level opportunities — and coaching helps bridge the gap between coursework and landing the job.

About the Role

We’re looking for part-time Procurement Career Coaches to support students through live workshops and optional 1:1 coaching.

This is not a traditional employment role and not a guaranteed-income position. It’s a flexible, paid opportunity best suited for professionals who want to mentor, teach, and build a small coaching practice on the side — with upside if students choose to work with you.

How This Role Actually Works

  • You host a live, one-hour workshop (seminar-style) for students

  • You are paid $50 for your workshop + Private business you acquire

  • Ability to receive exclusive coaching offers if you prove your abilities

  • Workshops are used to provide value, answer questions, and showcase your expertise

  • If students choose to book you for 1:1 coaching, you keep the coaching revenue

  • You set your own availability and working hours

There is no requirement to convert students, workshops are paid regardless, but conversion is where upside comes from.

Responsibilities

  • Host a live, one-hour workshop, on a monthly basis

  • Answer student questions related to the field and job search

  • Share real-world insight into what entry-level roles actually look like

  • Provide optional 1:1 coaching to students who request it

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience in the field

  • Interest in mentoring and helping career changers

  • Strong communication and teaching ability

  • Availability at least three evening per week, ideally Tuesday–Thursday

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable running your own workshops

Ideal Fit

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Enjoy teaching and mentoring

  • Want flexible, side income

  • Like the idea of being paid to teach — with optional upside

  • Don’t need guaranteed hours or full-time income

Compensation

  • $50 per one-hour workshop (One per month guaranteed)

  • Unlimited upside from 1:1 coaching sessions you convert

  • No caps, no quotas, no minimums

This individual will serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and product teams, translating business needs into technical requirements while driving platform enhancements, process improvements, and technology initiatives across the learning ecosystem.

This role is responsible for optimizing learning platform experiences, gathering and documenting business requirements, prioritizing enhancements, and partnering with Product and Engineering teams to deliver scalable, user-focused solutions.

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for learning technology platforms, including Adobe Learning Manager (ALM), Adobe Connect, Qualtrics, TidWit, SharePoint, and curriculum development tools such as Adobe Captivate and Articulate Rise.

raw.excerpt: Role Summary As Controller, you will own the integrity of Revamp’s financial reporting and help strengthen the systems, processes, and data quality that power everything from project execution to company-wide decision-making.
raw.description:
Role Summary

As Controller, you will own the integrity of Revamp’s financial reporting and help strengthen the systems, processes, and data quality that power everything from project execution to company-wide decision-making. Working closely with the VP of Finance & Operations and our outside accounting partners, you will lead the monthly close process, financial reporting, internal controls, forecasting, and financial analysis, lender compliance, audit readiness, tax and valuation support, and the financial narratives that leadership and employee-owners rely on. A strong Controller will independently own the company's accounting integrity, make sound judgment calls with limited oversight, and build the finance function needed for the company's next stage of growth. As part of an employee-owned firm founded to advance the global transition to renewable energy, this role has the opportunity to make an impact both internally and by moving our communities closer to a brighter, cleaner future.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Accounting Oversight + Financial Operations

  • Review the monthly close prepared by our outside accounting firm, including accruals, estimates, and support schedules; ensure issues are resolved before reporting.
  • Verify that accounting outputs reconcile to the budget, covenant calculations, and valuation model.
  • Exercise independent judgment on accruals, estimates, and accounting positions, and defend that judgment with outside advisors.
  • Step into lender, valuation, tax, and audit conversations as a prepared and credible backup to the VP of Finance & Operations.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP, company policies, lender requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Prepare quarterly lender compliance packages, including covenant calculations, compliance certificates, agings, supporting schedules, and drafts of the management narrative.
  • Prepare the annual valuation package for the company's independent valuation firm, including financial data, projection support, and diligence responses.
  • Design, maintain, and improve internal controls over financial reporting and key business processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement of accounting and financial systems, reporting automation, and internal controls.
  • Own the corporate tax calendar and prepare supporting schedules, data, and draft reviews for the provision and returns prepared by outside tax advisors, including multi-state and international dimensions.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the annual financial statement audit and employee benefit plan audits (401(k) and ESOP), running the PBC process and audit calendar end to end and bringing judgment calls to the VP of Finance & Operations.

Planning, Analysis + Communications

  • Run the annual budget and quarterly reforecast, coordinating schedule production with the outside accounting firm and owning the analysis and narrative.
  • Maintain the rolling 12-month forecast, including revenue, labor costs, and cash flow.
  • Monitor cash position, liquidity, and working capital needs while supporting banking and treasury relationships.
  • Develop portfolio projections, including backlog conversion and pipeline-weighted revenue.
  • Develop driver-based forecasting and scenario analysis to support leadership decisions on hiring, pricing, and growth.
  • Partner with operational leaders to develop actionable performance metrics and improve business decision-making.
  • Produce the monthly financial reporting package for the leadership team.
  • Develop and deliver regular financial communications to leadership and to all staff, translating financial results and structure for an audience of employee-owners.
  • Build and maintain the company's key metrics framework, including definitions, data sources, and tracking cadence.
  • Conduct periodic audits of the operational data (project accounting, time and billing systems) that feeds close, billing, and reporting, and drive corrections at the source.

Quality + Collaboration

  • Participate in leadership and project meetings and communicate financial work clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with outside accountants, tax advisors, auditors, valuation professionals, and lenders.
  • Collaborate with billing operations, project management, and department leaders to deliver accurate and complete financial work.
  • Contribute to a team culture rooted in accountability, curiosity, quality, and shared commitment to Revamp's clean energy mission and values of Impact, Collaboration, Trust, and Equity.
  • Mentor finance staff by answering technical questions, reviewing work, and modeling strong practices.
  • Lead the continued development of the finance function by strengthening processes, enhancing systems, and expanding internal capabilities.

Additional Duties

  • Perform essential duties, including meeting deliverables and deadlines.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned or directed.

Experience, Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related discipline.
  • Active CPA required; inactive CPA or CMA considered with equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience in industry or a combination of public accounting and industry roles.
  • Demonstrated experience building or rebuilding an accounting function, leading a team, and supporting external stakeholders (lenders, auditors, valuation firms, or investors).
  • Progressive accounting experience, including having personally led a monthly close process and designed, implemented, or improved accounting close procedures.
  • Working knowledge of GAAP, corporate tax compliance processes, and financial statement audit support.
  • Demonstrated FP&A capability, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial audiences directly and without jargon.
  • Demonstrated ability to review and challenge the work product of outside professionals constructively.
  • Detail-oriented and accurate.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, prioritize work, and meet deadlines across multiple recurring calendars.
  • Management experience or clear readiness for people management.
  • Collaborative approach to cross-functional coordination.
  • Experience with ASC 606 POC revenue recognition, ASC 842 lease accounting, and project-based accounting environments.

Preferred

  • Professional services or project-based business experience (engineering, AEC, construction, or similar).
  • Exposure to ESOP, leveraged, or other complex capital structures.
  • Hands-on involvement in a business valuation, transaction diligence, or lender reporting process.
  • Employee benefit plan audit experience (401(k), ESOP, or similar plans).
  • Experience in roles combining controllership with FP&A or decision support.
  • Experience overseeing outsourced accounting or managing significant outside advisor relationships.
  • Experience with project accounting and time and billing systems (e.g., QuickBooks Online, BigTime, or similar).

Benefits for Full-Time Positions:

  • Participation in Revamp's Employee Ownership ESOP program.
  • Competitive compensation with bonus.
  • Full benefits package including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.
  • Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.
  • Monthly health and wellness stipend.
  • Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.
  • Profit-sharing.
  • Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

About Revamp:

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier engineering design firm focused on large-scale renewable energy projects. We are committed to doing our part in the energy transition and providing a welcoming workplace for talented people ready to make a real difference fighting climate change. Since 2020, Revamp engineers have designed more than 10% of all solar generation capacity installed in the US.

We are made up of a diverse group of mostly remote, US-based employees spanning from the East Coast all the way to The Aloha State of Hawaii! We are artists, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, and travelers who embrace innovation and collaboration. For more information, visit our website at .

Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence! Cedars Sinai was awarded the National Research Corporation’s Consumer Choice Award 19 years in a row for providing the highest-quality medical care in Los Angeles. We also were awarded the Advisory Board Company’s Workplace of the Year. This annual award recognizes hospitals and health systems nationwide that have outstanding levels of employee engagement. We provide an outstanding benefit package that includes health care, paid time off and a 403(B). Join us! Discover why U.S. News & World Report has named us one of America’s Best Hospitals.

What you will be doing in this role:

The Claims Edit Coder (Coder II) operated under the general direction of an audit supervisor and involves responsibilities across various work units, as well as duties specific to the reporting team. In this role, the Coder II reviews ICD-10-CM diagnosis coding and Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) procedure code for claim edit fall outs. The position entails conducting modifier review and assignment, handling complex coding edits that necessitate research and resolution, and validating key data elements like the billing physician and date of service.

You are expected to abstract coded data accurately and promptly into the applicable system using relevant applications such as EPIC (CS-Link), EPIC HB and PB modules, Solventum 360Encompass, Solventum Standalone Encoder, and Select Coder. This role demands proficiency in these systems to ensure the integrity and efficiency of coding operations. Duties include:

  • Review medical documentation and health information within various electronic medical or health systems.
  • Assign applicable codes such as clinical modification (ICD-10-CM), current procedural terminology (CPT), evaluation and management (E&M), and healthcare common procedure coding system (HCPCS) while adhering to productivity and quality standards for the area(s) of assignment or specialty (Facility or Professional).

Job Title: QA Engineer - Ostro

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

At Veeva Ostro, we are transforming how life sciences connect with the people who need their innovations most. Every day, we help millions live healthier lives by bridging the gap between those who make medicines, treatments, and diagnostics and those who take them.

What You'll Do

We are seeking a detail-oriented QA Engineer who seamlessly bridges manual precision with automated efficiency. As a disciplined, self-starting problem solver, you take full ownership of software quality without needing micromanagement. Beyond core testing, you bring a strong curiosity for modern QA innovations, including AI-driven testing frameworks and LLM-based approaches, and a drive to help shape the future of our quality processes.

    • Develop and execute manual and automated test plans to ensure SaaS platform quality and reliability
    • Identify, document, and track software defects alongside development teams for rapid resolution
    • Create and maintain test cases, scripts, and data for functional and non-functional testing
    • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to align on requirements and expected behaviors
    • Research and implement AI-driven automation frameworks and LLM-based techniques to optimize testing
    • Conduct regression and performance testing to ensure system scalability
    • Integrate automated test suites directly into CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployments
    • Deliver clear, structured test reports and status updates to key stakeholders
    • Drive continuous QA process improvements independently with minimal oversight

Requirements

    • 3+ years in software quality assurance, mastering both manual precision and automated testing
    • Hands-on experience with frameworks like Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium, plus proficiency in JavaScript, Python, or Java
    • Proven ability to validate APIs using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or similar frameworks
    • Practical understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD) for automated test integration
    • Active interest in AI/ML-driven testing solutions and eagerness to experiment with LLM-based testing approaches
    • Strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and complex edge cases
    • Strong communication skills to partner effectively with Dev, Implementation, and Customer Support teams
    • Self-starter who prioritizes tasks, solves problems independently, and owns outcomes without micromanagement

Nice to Have

    • Experience with AI-driven test automation tools or LLM-based QA methodologies
    • Knowledge of SaaS environments and website-based software deployment
    • Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $70,000 - $120,000

The Opportunity:

More than 80% of Americans own a car and see it as one of their biggest financial commitments, yet managing one still means paperwork, phone holds, and switching between apps that don't talk to each other. Jerry.ai built the first app to manage it all (insurance shopping, refinancing, safety, and repairs) and since launching in 2019, we've grown to over 5M customers.

Every one of those customers holds an active policy with one of Jerry's 55+ insurance carrier partners, and their needs don't stop the day they sign up: cars get added, drivers move out, lienholders change. As a Customer Support Agent, you're the person who takes that call, makes the change, and keeps the policy (and the customer) with Jerry.

How you will make an impact:

  • Respond to inbound calls from existing customers

  • Process service requests such as adding/removing vehicles and drivers, adding lienholder information, sending policy documents, etc.

This role includes flexible scheduling options, with the choice between a 5-day, 8-hour schedule or a 4-day, 10-hour workweek.

Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

  • Identify gaps in the portfolio and source new strategic partners or solutions that enhance our marketing solutions offering

Revenue & Performance

  • Drive revenue growth and product adoption across the DMS portfolio
  • Establish and monitor margin targets by product category and vendor relationship
  • Develop packaging and bundling strategies that increase client value and support multi-product adoption

Vendor & Partner Leadership

  • Manage key vendor relationships and commercial agreements to ensure strong performance and alignment
  • Establish clear expectations, performance standards, and regular business reviews with partners
  • Make recommendations on vendor renewals, renegotiations, or exits based on performance and strategic fit

Sales Enablement & Go-to-Market

  • Partner with Sales leadership to integrate DMS solutions into client conversations in a clear, consultative way
  • Oversee development of sales enablement tools, training, and solution positioning
  • Ensure sellers understand DMS value, use cases, and how solutions complement core media offerings

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with key stakeholders on go-to-market strategies and product launches
  • Collaborate with Operations to ensure smooth onboarding, fulfillment, and delivery of DMS solutions
  • Align with Finance on forecasting, performance tracking, and reporting

Who You Are:

  • 7+ years of experience in digital marketing, product management, sales, or solutions leadership
  • Experience managing product portfolios, partnerships, or vendor ecosystems
  • Proven ability to drive revenue growth and product adoption, with a track record of translating strategy into execution that increases market penetration, accelerates sales performance, and delivers measurable business impact.
  • A strategic and forward-thinking leader who can see beyond today’s state and build a clear path toward scalable growth across the DMS product portfolio.
  • A product-minded operator with a commercial lens. You don’t just manage products, you think about how they win in market, how they’re positioned, and how they drive revenue.
  • A strong cross-functional leader who can align Sales, Marketing, and Product around a unified go-to-market strategy and ensure consistent execution.
  • Data-driven and outcome-oriented, with the ability to define, track, and optimize KPIs that directly tie to adoption, performance, and revenue growth.
  • An owner of clarity and focus, capable of rationalizing product offerings, prioritizing what matters most, and eliminating noise to drive meaningful impact.
  • A champion of innovation and experimentation, fostering a culture where testing, learning, and iterating are part of how the team operates, not the exception.
  • Customer-obsessed, with a deep understanding that strong products are built around real customer needs, market demand, and usability in the field.
  • Sales-minded and field-connected, able to step into the shoes of a seller, understand client conversations, and ensure the team is equipped with clear, compelling positioning.

raw.description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

About the Role

You will lead hiring across software engineering functions including backend, mobile, desktop, infrastructure, and product engineering. You will partner closely with founding teams, leadership and engineering leaders to identify and attract high-caliber talent globally.

This role requires strong judgment, speed, sourcing ability, and deep understanding of engineering talent quality beyond resumes and brand names.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end hiring for applications engineering roles globally

  • Source and engage high-quality software engineering talent across multiple markets

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and founders on hiring strategy and talent calibration

  • Assess candidate quality through career progression, technical depth, and execution signals

  • Drive interview coordination, candidate management, and closing processes

  • Improve recruiting processes, candidate experience, and hiring quality

  • Build strong pipelines for backend, mobile, desktop, and product engineering talent

What You'll Need

  • Proven experience recruiting software engineering talent in technology companies

  • Strong sourcing and talent mapping capability across global markets

  • Good understanding of engineering roles, technical stacks, and organizational structures

  • Ability to identify high-quality talent beyond pedigree and company brands

  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and candidate engagement ability

  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving and ambiguous environments

  • High ownership and strong execution ability

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

This role requires the candidate to work remotely from Germany.

Client Overview

Our client is a global artificial intelligence technology company specializing in the development of advanced large language models (LLMs), speech recognition technologies, multilingual AI systems, and data annotation solutions. The organization collaborates with leading AI research laboratories and enterprise technology companies worldwide to accelerate the development of next-generation artificial intelligence through high-quality human-generated data.

Supporting a diverse portfolio of multilingual AI initiatives, the company works with language specialists, voice professionals, and annotation experts across the globe to improve the accuracy, contextual understanding, and performance of cutting-edge AI systems used in speech processing, conversational AI, and natural language understanding.

Job Role

The German Audio QA Annotation Specialist is responsible for reviewing, evaluating, and validating German audio recordings to ensure they meet the highest quality standards required for AI speech recognition and audio annotation projects.

Working as part of a multilingual quality assurance team, this role focuses on assessing recording accuracy, pronunciation, fluency, audio clarity, annotation consistency, and compliance with project guidelines. The successful candidate will help ensure that all approved audio data contributes effectively to the development of advanced multilingual AI speech technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and evaluate German audio recordings for quality, pronunciation accuracy, clarity, and natural speech delivery.
  • Verify annotation accuracy and ensure all submitted recordings comply with project guidelines and quality standards.
  • Identify audio quality issues including background noise, recording inconsistencies, pronunciation errors, or technical defects.
  • Provide structured quality feedback and recommend improvements when recordings do not meet required standards.
  • Ensure consistency across annotated datasets by following established QA processes and evaluation criteria.
  • Collaborate with project reviewers and annotation teams to maintain high-quality multilingual datasets.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of review outcomes and quality assurance findings.
  • Support the continuous improvement of AI speech recognition models through high-quality audio validation.

Candidate Requirements

  • Native-level fluency in German with excellent listening comprehension and pronunciation knowledge.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in audio quality assurance, audio annotation, localization, transcription review, voice-over, dubbing, ADR, or related language quality roles.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify pronunciation, fluency, and audio quality issues accurately.
  • Excellent understanding of German linguistic nuances, regional accents, grammar, and natural speech patterns.
  • Experience reviewing audio recordings and applying quality standards consistently.
  • Familiarity with audio editing or audio playback software is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to provide clear and actionable quality feedback.
  • Ability to work independently while meeting project deadlines and quality targets.

raw.description:
Unlock Your Potential at Eaton: Where Diversity Drives Innovation.

At Eaton, we believe diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds drive innovation and success. We're committed to empowering people and creating a brighter, more sustainable future.

Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is one of the company's fastest-growing and most strategic businesses, helping power the digital economy. As cloud computing, AI, and high-density compute environments continue to accelerate, data centers face increasing demands for performance, resiliency, sustainability, and speed-to-market. Leveraging a broad portfolio of power, cooling, software, services, and infrastructure solutions, Eaton helps customers deploy scalable, integrated data center architectures that meet today's needs while preparing for the future.

Position Summary

Eaton is seeking a Senior Systems Architect – IT Module to join the Data Center Architecture Team.

This senior technical leadership role will define and drive the architecture of the data center IT Module (white space), including high-density power distribution, cooling integration, rack infrastructure, modular deployment strategies, and pod-level system design. The position serves as the primary systems integrator across white space components, ensuring scalable, repeatable, and optimized designs that enable rapid deployment of compute capacity for hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and next-generation AI data centers.

As a key member of the Data Center Architecture Team, you will help develop end-to-end reference architectures and collaborate directly with customers to shape future data center solutions.

What you’ll do:

Be knowledgeable of current trends and innovate the market.
Identify and build positive relationships with all account decision-makers and influencers who impact current or future business with Eaton.
Gain an in-depth understanding of the client development and buying process and be able to articulate it effectively.
Perform VoC by understanding and capturing clients' challenges and requirements and resolve them by co-designing to help evolving Eaton's portfolio.
Ensure an effective handover to Global Product Lines and Business Units so that they develop the right portfolio to respond to large customers’ requirements. Support the application engineers in charge of key accounts in implementing your designs for specific customers.
Maintain oversight of all advanced engineering-related engagements to ensure customer success and satisfaction, as well as Eaton's performance as a vendor.
Be highly knowledgeable about the client's business, commercial condition, structure, strategy, operations, and challenges. Articulate this knowledge in terms of opportunity, growth, and risk with respect to Eaton's business.
Be highly knowledgeable about Eaton's products, services, general business, structure, strategy, and operations. Articulate this knowledge in terms of value to the client's business.
Act as an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits of supporting your proposed architecture within the Eaton organization.
Act as an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits of supporting Eaton within the client engineering organization.
Collaborate effectively with other sales and stakeholders at the function, country, region, and global levels. Provide and gain support so others can meet their responsibilities to the account.
Provide all internal stakeholders and functional departments with the account-specific guidance and insights required to execute their roles and add value to the client.
Build a multi-lane bridge between Eaton and the client organization. This may include GPL leaders, Engineering leaders, Product line managers, BU Engineers, BDM, Marketing, PMO, Services, Sales Operations & Order Management, Supply Chain, Leadership & Executive Management.
Work with the Segment Marketing team to create white papers and other technical material to promote our designs and value proposition.

Qualifications:

Leadership & experience: 15+ years in critical power system design and electrical distribution engineering (advanced degree strongly preferred).

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent recognized qualification
Minimum of 10 years of related experience in the data center business across core domains of whitespace, cooling, power, fiber, controls, and rack systems

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters degree in engineering or technical discipline

Skills:

Has led multiple complex programs delivering medium- and low-voltage power architectures for large data centers or similar mission-critical facilities, spanning from medium-voltage (e.g. 15–35 kV) substation design to high-current low-voltage and ~1500 V direct-current systems. Experience includes end-to-end oversight from conceptual architecture through deployment, with a record of on-time, reliable power system commissioning at multi-megawatt scale.
Technical expertise: Expert in power conversion architectures for data centers, including MV AC distribution, LV AC, and high-voltage DC networks. Mastery of protective coordination, converter and switchgear integration, busway and panelboard systems, large-scale UPS and energy storage, and DC power protection schemes. Keeps abreast of emerging 380 → 800 V DC standards and cutting-edge power electronics (e.g. new 800 VDC components) and is a recognized innovator (patents or contributions to industry standards such as OCP open DC architectures or IEC committees on data center power).
Systems & architecture skills: Thinks at system level beyond the white space – ensures the IT Module design aligns with upstream power (Block 2) and facility cooling systems (Block 4) for a cohesive data center architecture. Provides direction across multiple product and engineering teams (racks, busbars, cooling, monitoring, etc.) to develop standardized, integrated solutions. Mentors multi-disciplinary engineers and champions a shift from traditional, labor-intensive buildouts to automated, modular deployment approaches that improve speed-to-market and reliability.
Leadership & communication: Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive leadership and initiative, with experience guiding cross-functional teams or projects. Demonstrated mentoring ability and influence in a matrixed organization, helping train and direct other engineers.
Customer focus: Strong customer engagement skills – experience interacting with enterprise or hyperscale data center customers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that address their challenges. Ability to incorporate Voice of Customer feedback into technical designs and roadmaps.

Technical knowledge in data centers design and construction, specifically POD-level architecture and modular design, high-density compute environments (AI/ML workloads) and/or liquid cooling architectures
Project Management Experience: Experience with Product Design or Product Management with a working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Waterfall. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite is required
Specialized Industry Knowledge: Ability to create customized data center physical layer solutions tailored to various data center subsegments, including (but not limited to) Hyperscale, liquid cooling, and the modular edge
DMAIC experience for process improvement and drive for excellence
Experience delivering POD-level architecture and modular design
High-density compute environments (AI/ML workloads) and cross-domain system integration (cooling, power, structural)
Proven ability to author whitepapers and thought leadership and lead system-level design trade-off discussions
To perform effectively, the individual shall maintain sufficient market and competitor intelligence, understand client and market primary trends and requirements and how competition addresses them and how Eaton uniquely and preferentially meets them
Highly proficient at consultative selling and at communicating Eaton's differentiated value at company, product, and service levels. Additionally, function in a research and development function
Strong customer-facing technical engagement experience

What will make you successful:

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience leading large-scale, mission-critical power architectures from concept through deployment.
  • Technical;
    • Medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution
    • UPS systems
    • Energy storage
    • Power electronics
    • AC and DC power architectures
    • Protective coordination
    • Switchgear and busway systems
  • Knowledge of emerging high-voltage DC architectures and future power distribution technologies.

Leadership & Influence

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive, engineering, and operational audiences.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in matrixed organizations.
  • Demonstrated success mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction.

Customer-Focused Innovation

  • Strong customer-facing experience working with enterprise or hyperscale data center operators.
  • Ability to incorporate customer requirements into product roadmaps and solution architectures.
  • Proven ability to develop white papers, technical publications, and thought leadership content.

Continuous Improvement

  • Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, or DMAIC methodologies.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and traditional project management methodologies.

raw.excerpt: Na Atlas, temos pessoas apaixonadas, curiosas, questionadoras e ousadas, que buscam soluções de impacto para acelerar o nosso crescimento.
raw.description:
Na Atlas, temos pessoas apaixonadas, curiosas, questionadoras e ousadas, que buscam soluções de impacto para acelerar o nosso crescimento. Aqui, unimos tecnologia, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento, respeito e diversidade para construir relações significativas e duradouras.

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham brilho nos olhos diante de desafios e que desejem contribuir para a construção de um mundo melhor.

Temos um compromisso firme com a inclusão, a diversidade e o pertencimento. Não toleramos qualquer tipo de preconceito, porque acreditamos que inovação e transformação só florescem em ambientes de trabalho diversos e seguros.

Reforçamos que nossas vagas são especialmente destinadas a pessoas negras, indígenas, mulheres, LGBTQIA+, pessoas com deficiência (PCD) e todas as demais representações da diversidade. Junte-se a nós e seja parte dessa transformação!

Descrição da vaga:

Estamos procurando uma Pessoa Engenheira de Software Pleno para atuar no desenvolvimento da nossa plataforma Atlas Gov V3. Buscamos alguém com forte domínio técnico em back-end e que utilize IA generativa como parte real do seu fluxo de trabalho — ferramentas como Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou similares — para entregar mais qualidade e velocidade no dia a dia. Não buscamos apenas conhecimento técnico tradicional, mas gente que já incorporou AI como parte natural de como constrói software.

O que você vai fazer no seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver softwares de alta qualidade utilizando C# .NET Framework, .NET Core, Web API, SQL Server, Azure Functions, Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de AI (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou similares) como parte ativa do fluxo de desenvolvimento — para geração, revisão e refatoração de código, debugging e aceleração de entregas;
  • Identificar, priorizar e executar tarefas no ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de softwares;
  • Projetar e manter integrações com serviços Azure (Service Bus, SignalR, Key Vault, Cognitive Search);
  • Desenvolver ferramentas e aplicativos por meio de códigos inteligíveis e eficientes;
  • Automatizar tarefas por meio de ferramentas e linguagem de scripting adequadas;
  • Revisar e depurar códigos;
  • Executar testes de validação e verificação;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas e fornecedores para corrigir e aprimorar produtos;
  • Documentar fases de desenvolvimento e monitorar sistemas;
  • Assegurar que os softwares estejam atualizados com as mais recentes tecnologias.

Requisitos para a posição de Engenheiro de Software:

  • Sólida experiência na área;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software utilizando .NET e C#;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais (por exemplo, SQL Server, MySQL) e bancos de dados NoSQL (por exemplo, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem, especialmente Azure;
  • Uso avançado e comprovado de ferramentas de AI no fluxo de trabalho de desenvolvimento (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares) — não apenas conhecimento superficial, mas prática real de produtividade aumentada por AI;
  • Experiência com GIT para controle de versão;
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes para gerenciamento de containers e orquestração;
  • Conhecimento de APIs REST;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em React ou front-end;
  • Experiência com integração de IAs generativas.

A contratação é em modelo de Cooperativa e alguns dos nossos benefícios:

  • Ajuda de custo em Plano de saúde;
  • Ajuda de custo para home office;
